subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the security and workflow owners approve updating all 14 executable action pins as one batch after a rebase and green relevant exact-head checks?
rationale: The diff is mechanically narrow, but several updated actions mint tokens, receive secrets, execute Codex, publish container images, or upload security results, so accepting the upstream code changes is an explicit repository trust-boundary decision.

options.title: Approve the refreshed batch
options.body: Rebase the PR, inspect the final exact pins, require green relevant checks, and approve the coordinated dependency refresh as one change.

options.title: Split credential-bearing updates
options.body: Land routine setup, labeler, and stale updates separately while reviewing token, Codex, Docker publishing, and CodeQL pins in smaller owner-approved PRs.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Pause the refresh if owners cannot presently validate the upstream credential and execution boundary changes.

recommendation.title: Approve the refreshed batch
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, inspect the final exact pins, require green relevant checks, and approve the coordinated dependency refresh as one change.

likelyOwner.reason: They are explicitly listed as a dependency-guard security approver and have relevant merged Docker release workflow history.
